column7: The per-account lockout (the only bound on step-up and recovery-code guessing) dropped a failure whenever its lockout-column write failed (recordFailedLogin was best-effort with nothing behind it), so with that write down an account never locked. Now the failure is counted in the shared limiter's in-memory account_lockout fallback, which loginLocked and the pre-mint re-check consult; a delivered login and UnlockUser clear it. Red on the parent: after MaxAttempts wrong step-up codes / passwords the correct one was accepted; green: refused as locked. TestAccountLockout_StateStorageDown_PasswordLoginStillLocks covers the password path; _BelowTheLimitStillLogsIn and _HealthyStorage_FallbackStaysEmpty are the calibrations.
